scripts.docker:build:backend: node scripts/check-lockfile.mjs && docker build --secret id=npmrc,src=${NPMRC:-$HOME/.npmrc} -f apps/backend/Dockerfile -t helix-x-rawla-backend:${TAG:-local} .
scripts.docker:build:frontend: node scripts/check-lockfile.mjs && docker build --secret id=npmrc,src=${NPMRC:-$HOME/.npmrc} -f apps/frontend/Dockerfile -t helix-x-rawla-frontend:${TAG:-local} .
scripts.docker:builder: docker buildx inspect rawla-builder >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker buildx create --name rawla-builder --driver docker-container

scripts.docker:push:frontend: node scripts/check-lockfile.mjs && pnpm docker:builder && docker buildx build --builder rawla-builder --platform ${DOCKER_PLATFORMS:-linux/amd64,linux/arm64} --secret id=npmrc,src=${NPMRC:-$HOME/.npmrc} -f apps/frontend/Dockerfile -t ${DOCKER_REGISTRY:-docker.allquill.com}/helix-x-rawla-frontend:${TAG:-local} --push .
